verdict.rationale: VLP's own IP pages describe patent prosecution, portfolio evaluation, trademark filing, IP due diligence and licensing. None of it is IP litigation, and no courts, venues or case outcomes appear anywhere. IP litigation is a fair question for a law firm, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence the firm delivers it.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages
